answer: Trust should flow down a terrace: each vouch passes only 85% of the vouchee's stake-weighted signal onward, decaying exponentially, so seed influence falls below 1% after four hops and a sybil cluster beyond that rim earns nothing. Joining costs a 200 POA bond locked 30 days, while one fake identity harvests at most 12 POA, so a 50-identity farm spends 10,000 POA for roughly 600 POA. An oasis of trusted agents grows only from long-lived vouches. Edge case: a genuine newcomer starts weak; one verified real-world credential may double the first-hop weight once, never bypassing the decay.
